messages.title: my serenity
messages.message: im very sorry if your feeling sad right now, i know you are independent woman but sometimes you need comfort in this cruel world. im here for you no matter what. keep slayin babi, i love you.

messages.title: I miss you too
messages.message: hi babi!, its rare for me to that you miss me but for me i treasure all the time that we are together. and i really miss you too. keep safe whereever you are and I love you.
